Game Overview

Sprunki Horror Version Dark is a platformer title where navigate a nightmarish world with the Sprunki characters, avoiding deadly thorns and traps. Constant movement is your ally as you journey through a pitch-dark forest. Master ambiguous controls to reach the portal and liberate yourself from this haunting realm. Can you escape the shadows unscathed?
